attestations.text: TING Ping 丁丙 (T. 嘉魚, 松生, 松存), Aug. 15, 1832–1899, Apr. 18, bibliophile, publisher and philanthropist, was a native of Ch'ien-t'ang (Hangchow). An ancestor of the Ting family, named Ting K'ai 丁顗, accumulated a collection of books comprising 8,000 chüan.
